segments.he:
ג.

עַל-יְדֵי עַזּוּת לֹא יְקַבֵּל מוּסָר.
segments.en: Through brazenness, one’s heart becomes armored and it is also certain that he has yet to repair the sins of his father.

segments.he:
ד.

עַל-יְדֵי עַזּוּת נַעֲשֶׂה אַבִּיר-לֵב, גַּם בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁעֲדַיִן לֹא תִּקֵּן פִּשְׁעֵי אָבִיו.
segments.en: One who is brazen, his rectification is to don Tefillin (phylacteries) that had been on the head of a Tzaddik. When an evildoer acts brazenly before an upright man, this is only so that the upright one will examine his deeds.

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶּׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַזּוּת, תִּקּוּנוֹ - שֶׁיַּנִּיחַ תְּפִלִּין, שֶׁהָיוּ עַל רֹאשׁ צַדִּיק.
segments.en: One who is brazen, assuredly he is not making do with what he has. The Torah is a rectification for brazenness.

segments.he:
ו.

כְּשֶׁרָשָׁע מֵעֵז בִּפְנֵי יָשָׁר, אֵין זֶה אֶלָּא כְּדֵי שֶׁהַיָּשָׁר יְפַשְׁפֵּשׁ בְּמַעֲשַׂיו.
segments.en: Through brazenness, rains are withheld. And it is certain that he stumbled in a sin and, in the end, will stumble in more sin.

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עַזּוּת, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִסְתַּפֵּק בְּמַה שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ.
segments.en: It is permitted to call him "wicked", and it is permitted to hate him, and he is from one of the 974 generations.

segments.he:
ח.

הַתּוֹרָה הִיא תִּקּוּן לְעַזּוּת. א.

מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ עַזּוּת, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁעָבַר עֲבֵרָה לְהַכְעִיס. ט.

עַל-יְדֵי עַזּוּת גְּשָׁמִים נֶעֱצָרִים, וּבְיָדוּעַ שֶׁנִּכְּשֶׁל בַּעֲבֵרָה, וְסוֹפוֹ שֶׁיִּכְּשֶׁל בַּעֲבֵרָה, וּמֻתָּר לִקְרוֹתוֹ רָשָׁע, וּמֻתָּר לִשְׂנֹאתוֹ, וְהוּא אֶחָד מתתקע"ד ]מֵהַתְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה[ דּוֹרוֹת.
segments.en:
[that were to precede the giving of the Torah, but because H”Y understood that the world couldn't manage that long without the Torah so he spread those generations throughout the rest of history].

One who is brazen, it is certain that he has transgressed out of spite. Brazenness comes through anger.

Audacity, even against Heaven, is effective, but it is considered as ruling without a crown (i.e. illegitimately).

segments.he:
י.



חֻצְפָּה אֲפִלּוּ כְּלַפֵּי שְׁמַיָּא מְהַנֵּי, וְהוּא מַלְכוּתָא בְּלָא תַּגָּא.
segments.en: 9. One who follows the advice of his wife falls into Hell.

segments.he:
ב.

עַזּוּת בָּא עַל-יְדֵי כַּעַס. א.

כְּשֶׁרוֹאִין שֶׁהָעוֹלָם מְעִיזִין פְּנֵיהֶם כְּנֶגֶד הַתַּלְמִיד-חָכָם, יֵדְעוּ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי מִלְחָמוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת יִתְעוֹרְרוּ עַל מְדִינָה הַזֹּאת.
segments.en:
Through brazenness, one will not accept Mussar (ethical criticism).

10. Do not ask advice; only from a man, and not from a woman.

segments.he:
יא. 

כְּאֵב הָרֹאשׁ בָּא עַל שֶׁמֵעֵז פָּנָיו כְּנֶגֶד זֶרַע דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ.
segments.en:
1. One who is brazen, it is certain that he has transgressed out of spite.

Headaches come upon one who is brazen to the face of someone from the seed of King David.
